symbols.name: SoundScript__skipFilter
symbols.note: First stage of the `.ssc` per-line pipeline and the whole of the engine's comment handling. `/*` and `beginSkip` are one mechanism, not two: `if (line == "endSkip" || line.find("*/") != npos) { g_sscSkipping = 0; return 1; }` then `if (g_sscSkipping) return 1;` then `if (line == "beginSkip" || line.find("/*") != npos) { g_sscSkipping = 1; return 1; }` else return 0. Consequences, all relied on by shipped data: the unit is the LINE, not the character span (`/*load @ROOT/...` in XPack2 `Gewehr43_zf4/Sounds/High.ssc` loses the `load` with it); the close test runs first and unconditionally, so a `*/` with no opener is silently eaten (vanilla `KettenKradEngine.ssc`) and a self-contained `/* ... */` on one line never opens a skip; and an opener needs no terminator — it skips to the end of the parse (vanilla `LynxHorn.ssc`, and 373 of the 849 scripts that use the markers). Returning 1 means the line is consumed, so being first it also swallows `#include` and `#templateLevel` inside a skipped region.

symbols.name: SoundScript__readLine
symbols.note: Reads one `.ssc` line from the current include stream: clears the string, then appends bytes until `\n`, discarding `\r`. No trimming — the line handed to the filters carries its own leading whitespace, so `beginSkip`/`endSkip` match only unindented (their test is `operator==`), while `/*` and `*/` are substring searches and match anywhere on the line.

symbols.name: SoundScript__handleTemplateLevel
symbols.note: `#templateLevel` for `.ssc` — the Options -> Sound detail tier. Second in the per-line pipeline, after the skip filter.

symbols.name: SoundScript__handleInclude
symbols.note: `#include` for `.ssc`. Fourth in the per-line pipeline 0x007fb0e0, so it runs only on lines the skip filter let through.

symbols.name: SoundScript__handleBeginMap
symbols.note: `#beginMap` / `#endMap` for `.ssc`: declares the extern channels the owning object feeds (`Engine::Rpm` and friends). Third in the per-line pipeline.

symbols.name: SoundScript__resetParseState
symbols.note: Clears all `.ssc` parser globals after a top-level parse: the skip flag 0x00a8fb30, the current patch/sample pointers 0x00a8fb28 / 0x00a8fb2c, the `#beginMap` channel 0x0095ac7c / 0x00a8fb34, and the patch list at 0x00a8fcc0. Called once from SoundScript__parse 0x007fb1c0, never per included file — which is what makes the skip flag outlive an include.

symbols.name: SoundScript__handleLine
symbols.note: The `.ssc` per-line pipeline, in order: skipFilter 0x007f9a80, then `#templateLevel` 0x007fa010, then `#beginMap`/`#endMap` 0x007fad10, then `#map` 0x007f9be0, then `#include` 0x007fa3f0, then `newPatch` 0x007f9a00; anything left falls through to the 23-entry command table built by 0x007fde70. The skip filter being first is what makes a comment outrank every directive.

symbols.name: SoundScript__parse
symbols.note: Top-level `.ssc` parse: open, then `while (!atEof()) { readLine 0x007f9ed0; handleLine 0x007fb150 -> 0x007fb0e0; }`, then finalize 0x007f9db0 and resetParseState 0x007fb040.
